mapper.insert: insert into CHB_SYS_USER_ROLE_HIS(USER_ID, HIS_NO, ROLE_ID, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select USER_ID, (select IFNULL(max(HIS_NO), 0) from CHB_SYS_USER_ROLE_HIS where STATUS IN('E','D')) + 1 as HIS_NO, ROLE_ID, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as UPDATE_TIME from CHB_SYS_USER_ROLE where STATUS IN('E','D')
